invariants.expression: result == Color.toFloatBits(batchColor.r * layer.getCombinedTintColor().r, batchColor.g * layer.getCombinedTintColor().g, batchColor.b * layer.getCombinedTintColor().b, batchColor.a * layer.getCombinedTintColor().a * layer.getOpacity())
invariants.rationale: By definition of the method, result is the output of Color.toFloatBits with these computed arguments.
Layer opacity for rendering is normally clamped between 0 and 1.
Color channel values in color representations are typically in the [0,1] range.
Alpha tint color is expected to be in normalized [0,1] range.
A float representation of color bits as packed RGBA typically yields a non-negative float.
